summary: Jefferson Capital, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to an existing credit agreement. The amendment, entered on April 22, 2026, increases revolving credit commitments from $1,000,000,000 to $1,150,000,000 and raises the future increase cap to $1,425,000,000. The borrowers include various subsidiaries of the registrant, with Citizens Bank as administrative agent. No other material changes were made. This filing is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or capital return. No deal terms are disclosed beyond the credit commitment increase. Watch for future utilization of expanded capacity.
